label: Infant Mortality Rate
description: Deaths per 1,000 live births before age 1. Sourced from SRS annual bulletins & World Bank indicators.
sourceReport: Sample Registration System (SRS) / World Bank Data

label: Maternal Mortality Ratio
description: Maternal deaths per 100,000 live births. Sourced from SRS bulletins and World Bank / WHO health databases.
sourceReport: SRS Special Bulletins / WHO / World Bank

label: Total Fertility Rate
description: Average number of children born per woman. Sourced from SRS bulletins, NFHS surveys & UN Population Division.

label: Literacy Rate
description: Percentage of the population aged 7 years and above who can read and write with understanding.
sourceReport: Census of India / NSO Survey / UDISE+

label: GER (Secondary)
description: Gross Enrolment Ratio at the secondary level (Classes IX–X). Sourced from UDISE+ / Ministry of Education.

label: Higher Education GER
description: Gross Enrolment Ratio in Higher Education (18–23 age group). Target under NEP 2020: 50% by 2035.
sourceReport: All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE)

label: Higher Education Enrolment
description: Total student enrolment in higher education institutions (universities, colleges, and stand-alone institutes). Sourced from AISHE.

label: Per Capita Income
description: Net State Domestic Product / Net National Income per capita at current prices in Indian Rupees.

label: GDP Growth Rate
description: Real GDP growth rate year-on-year percentage change. Sourced from MoSPI, RBI & World Bank.

label: Labour Force Participation Rate
description: Percentage of the working-age population (15+) that is either employed or seeking employment (usual status, principal + subsidiary).

label: Unemployment Rate (Usual Status)
description: Percentage of the labour force (15+) that is without work and seeking employment under Usual Status (Principal + Subsidiary Status, PS+SS).

label: Female LFPR
description: Labour Force Participation Rate for women aged 15 and above (usual status).

label: Youth Unemployment (15-24)
description: Unemployment rate among the youth population aged 15-24 years (usual status).

label: Agricultural GDP Growth
description: Year-on-year growth rate of Gross Value Added (GVA) from agriculture and allied sectors at constant prices.

label: Foodgrain Production
description: Total production of foodgrains (rice, wheat, coarse cereals, pulses) in million tonnes.
sourceReport: Agricultural Statistics at a Glance / Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

label: Total Population
description: Total population in crores. Sourced from Census of India, RGI Population Projections & UN Population Division.
sourceReport: Census of India / RGI / UN Data

label: Sex Ratio
description: Number of females per 1,000 males in the total population. Sourced from Census & NFHS.

label: Poverty Headcount Ratio
description: Percentage of the population living below the national poverty line (Tendulkar methodology / NITI Aayog MPI).

label: Human Development Index
description: Composite index measuring average achievement in health, education, and standard of living.
sourceReport: UNDP Human Development Report / NITI Aayog / GDL

label: IPC Crime Rate
description: Rate of cognizable crimes registered under the Indian Penal Code (IPC) per 1,00,000 population. (Note: Higher registered crime rates reflect higher reporting/registration).

label: Total Cognizable Crime Rate (IPC + SLL)
description: Total rate of cognizable crimes registered under both IPC (Indian Penal Code) and SLL (Special & Local Laws) per 1,00,000 population.

label: Murder Rate
description: Rate of murders (Section 302 IPC / Section 103 BNS) per 1,00,000 population.

label: Crimes Against Women
description: Rate of total crimes against women (including assault, sexual harassment, kidnapping, dowry deaths, rape) per 1,00,000 female population.

label: Cyber Crimes
description: Total number of cyber crime cases registered under the IT Act and IPC, in thousands.
